CPU and memory of the connected computer, kept current at a glance.

Tap to copy to your clipboard.
Your computer at a glance: four readings as tiles. Resize it freely — it rearranges to fit.
Open Maze Connect and pair to see your computer here.
The smallest: your computer\u2019s name and two readings.
A square: two readings, each with its detail — temperature, used of total.
Every reading with the computer\u2019s detail beside it, plus hardening, services and network.
A slim strip: name, freshness and three meters in one row.
Killswitches on the home screen: tap to block or allow the camera, microphone, Wi-Fi or Bluetooth.
Favourite commands on the home screen: tap to run one your computer marked as pinned.
Nothing pinned yet. On your computer\'s Commands page, mark an entry to show it here.
That command is no longer on the computer\'s list.
Still running — open the app to see the result.
Maze Connect could not start. Open the app once, then try again.
No paired computer answered. Check that it is on the same network and Maze Connect is running there.
No paired computer is reachable right now.
Play, pause and skip what is playing on your computer, from the lock screen and the notification shade.
